Container.Name: YunKan-UI
Container.Overview:
Unofficial YunKan / SkyView web workbench: free-form live mosaic, AI events, timeline playback. Does not replace the YunKan-OpenVINO container — reverse-proxies local API :23326 and HLS :23406.
云瞰非官方 Web 工作台。先让 YunKan / SkyView 在本机跑起来（host 网络，23326 + 23406），再拉取镜像： docker pull s1oz/yunkan-ui:latest 或： docker compose up -d --build
WebUI 用官方同一套账号登录。演示：地址后加 ?demo=1。
Container.Requires: A running YunKan / SkyView container on this host (ports 23326 and 23406). Pull s1oz/yunkan-ui:latest from Docker Hub, or build from https://github.com/s1oz/yunkan-ui.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Workbench HTTP port. Host network binds 18081 on the Unraid host.

Config.Name: Backend API
Config.Description: YunKan REST API. Use 127.0.0.1 with host networking; on bridge, use the Unraid LAN IP.

Config.Name: Media / stock admin
Config.Description: Official web UI + HLS media. Use 127.0.0.1 with host networking.

Config.Name: Listen PORT
Config.Description: Must match the Web UI port above.

Config.Name: UI source (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Map the git clone so HTML/JS edits apply on restart without rebuilding. Leave empty to use files baked into the image.
